entities.summary: Duan Xiong, titled Duke Zhongzhuang of Bao, better known by his courtesy name as Duan Zhixuan, was a general and officer of the early Tang dynasty. He is one of 24 honored founding officials of the Tang dynasty at Lingyan Pavilion.
